title: Proposal For Highest Tier of Silver Support for Seniors Above 80 Who Live in Smaller HDB Flats
what_it_is: Proposal For Highest Tier of Silver Support for Seniors Above 80 Who Live in Smaller HDB Flats

sections.label: Silver Support Scheme eligibility and payments
sections.summary: The Silver Support Scheme supports seniors aged 65 and above with lower lifetime incomes and little family support, with payments based on lifetime wages, housing type and household support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The Silver Support Scheme is a targeted support scheme which provides support to seniors aged 65 and above, who had lower incomes during their working years and now have little or no family support and resources in their retirement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Eligibility is determined by the senior's lifetime wages, housing type and the level of household support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Eligible seniors living in smaller flats with fewer financial resources will receive higher payments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: The Silver Support Scheme is part of a wider set of social support measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: These include the Workfare Income Supplement and the annual Earn and Save Bonus under the Majulah Package, which help boost the retirement savings of lower- to middle-income working seniors and can increase their Central Provident Fund (CPF) LIFE payouts.

sections.label: ComCare and flat type complaints
sections.summary: Seniors needing further assistance can apply for ComCare at their nearest Social Service Office, and a Member of Parliament raised residents' complaints about flat type and Silver Support payments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Seniors who need further assistance to meet their basic living needs can approach their nearest Social Service Office to apply for ComCare.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Loh (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: I only have a specific question with regard to my earlier question on flat type.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Loh (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: I cannot be the only Member of Parliament in this House who has had residents come up to me, who live in 5-room flats, to complain that their neighbours who live in 4-room flats are getting more from the Silver Support Scheme.

sections.label: Fiscal prudence and Silver Support
sections.summary: The speaker says fiscal prudence and sustainability must be balanced, and hopes the Silver Support Scheme can eventually shrink to a very small proportion.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Like I said earlier on, we have to balance it between fiscal prudence and fiscal sustainability.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Of course, I hope for the day, through the collective efforts of all of us here, where we have done so well that we are able to upstream and ensure that every Singaporean has enough in their golden years; they can meet all of their Full Retirement Sum needs; and the Silver Support Scheme can then wither down to just a very small proportion.
